pieces.Text: You can channel a touch range power through a melee weapon.  You can make a single melee attack during the same action in which you manifest a touch power with a manifesting time of one standard action; if this melee attack hits, it triggers the power as if you had succeeded on a touch attack and deals damage as normal.  If you miss, the power fizzles and the charge is lost.  This attack is made against standard AC and not touch AC.
